summary: Critical outage in auth-service caused by cache_issue (INC-0016)
description: Service auth-service incident INC-0016. Symptoms: cache hit ratio dropped from 95% to 40%. Error: redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Error 111 connecting to 10.0.1.20:6379. Connection refused. Root cause was cache_issue. Followed runbook RB-cache-stampede.

comments.author: devops1
comments.body: Restarted service pods for auth-service and applied RB-cache-stampede.
